architecture.consumption_order: event order within a simulation (schedule() consumes pool[cursor] as events are scheduled); pool is bulk-drawn, so consumption order across events is data-dependent via event times, but the (sim_id -> full draw sequence) mapping is fixed
architecture.contract_version_tag: sha256(contract_version)[:4] mixed as third entropy word
architecture.domains: R5 pace/residual stream frozen as rng_for_simulation (3-word entropy); R6 domains add a 4th word; MC2 uses own tag mc2-rng-v1 + domain mc2-ar1 (never perturbs R3/R6)
architecture.per_simulation_stream: mc2_stream(master_seed, sim_id): one dedicated Generator per simulation id

description: P0 RNG architecture map. Per-simulation streams make future-level parallelism exact by construction.

ordering_chunking_risks.chunked_trials: NO RISK: documented chunk invariant; one stream per simulation consumed in event order regardless of chunking
ordering_chunking_risks.reordered_drivers: NO RISK within run_mc2: roster order fixed by initial_state.drivers; per-sim streams independent of driver iteration for RNG identity (event-order consumption is deterministic given fixed inputs)
ordering_chunking_risks.reordered_trials: NO RISK: sim_id-keyed streams; aggregation (winner_counts, positions) is order-independent summation
ordering_chunking_risks.worker_count: NO RISK: streams keyed by scientific identity (seed, sim_id), never by worker/scheduler

random_consumption.ar1: empirical draws via sampler.sample_unit(uniform) from the per-sim pool; AR(1) recursion deterministic given draws
random_consumption.other_domains: pit/compound/reliability domains exist in R6 but MC2 E-arm path consumes only the MC2 pace pool (pits-off, dry-green, no DNF simulation)
random_consumption.per_driver_identity: none: no per-driver stream; all draws come from the per-simulation pool in event order
random_consumption.per_trial_identity: simulation_id -> SeedSequence -> PCG64 stream; bulk rng.random(bound) per sim
random_consumption.retirement_reliability: none consumed (no retirement dynamics in MC2)
random_consumption.tyre_performance: deterministic (expected_lap_time_s degradation); stochasticity only via residual draws
